notes: All quantities are SI, float64, written with full precision.
Rays start at observer.position; direction is a unit vector in scene axes.
chords: path length of the ray inside each object's FULL shape (children included), not its own region.
alpha is null where the material has no friction (emission set by luminosity).

Rays labelled limb:* pass a sphere's centre at the stated fraction of its radius; horizon:* pass the ground sphere's centre at radius + the stated offset. Near a limb a chord is sensitive to the direction: an error db in the impact parameter changes it by 2 b db / (half chord).

counts: gravitons per second per square metre of collecting area from each picture element of a view (rows from the top), cells[0] x cells[1] square elements of the tangent plane, each sampled on samples x samples rays weighted by their solid angles; balls narrower than a sample's spacing (points) counted whole in the element of their centre. Rounded to 10 significant digits; rate_without_room leaves the background out.

tidal.convention: E_ij = d_i d_j Phi (Newtonian potential Phi), s^-2; rows and columns are the scene axes x, y, z

earth_layers.note: Superposition of uniform spheres with the scene's density contrasts; the mass is the total those densities imply.

sun.note: The Sun is taken as a point-like uniform sphere of the standard solar mass 1.98847e30 kg at the scene's Sun centre, NOT a sum over the scene's two uniform layers; their densities are chosen to give the same mass (scene_density_mass).
